mission.title: The Gathering Storm
mission.description: Save the Merovingian's Exiles from Zion and Machine attacks, and look for the Effectuator.

npc.say: You picked the wrong place, friend.
You picked the wrong place, friend.

phase.briefing:
Remember when I mentioned raining and pouring? Well, it's turned into a regular deluge now. Time for some damage control!
We've got an attack in progress on some of our Exiles. Go bail them out.

enter.say: There are some Dire Lupines under attack by the General's men in here. Don't let any of those commandos make it out!

done.say:
Looks like those commandos made short work of the wolves... I didn't realize they were so powerful!
Anyhow, you can get out of there now.

phase.briefing: That certainly is unfortunate that you didn't save them, {player}. We have another location under attack, by those insipid toasters this time. Perhaps you'll show a little more, ah, initiative this time?

enter.say: Machine signals all over the place in there! You've got your work cut out for you.

done.say: Dire Lupines again... aren't they the Effectuator's bodyguards?

phase.briefing:
You are beginning to displease me, {player}. I expect more... how should I say... hustle?
Bah! I have no time to reprimand you properly. The Effectuator is being moved on as we speak. A team of Machine operatives is at his location. Of course there really isn't much to fear, as the Effectuator has his own methods of escape. But we cannot stand for this kind of affront to our people! Go there and destroy the toasters!

enter.say: It's always hard to read signals when the Effectuator is involved, you know... you're going to have to look around and find out what's up in there.

done.say: Getting warmer... I'm reading his signal just a bit further on.
Almost there. I think he's through the far door.

Okay, the Effectuator should be right--
What?!? Gone? I don't think he teleported out... this is not good.

mission.finish:
He's gone.
This is it. I'm finished.
I'm finished, do you hear me?!? And all because of your incompetence! I'm taking you down with me, if it's the last thing I do!
